english:
Being hit by a Melee Attack while Force Absorption is active releases a disorienting burst that disorients enemies within 7.2 meters for 4 seconds.

Can only trigger once per Reactive Shock activation.

source.text:
4 Piece | Reactive Shock

While Force Absorption is active:
Being hit by a Melee Attack triggers a Disorienting Burst, disorienting enemies within 7.2 meters for 4 seconds.
Can only trigger once per Reactive Shock activation.
